integrity: The universal statement is proved analytically from the exact outside-neighbor counts of selected vertices according to whether their deleted mate is selected. A standalone verifier independently checks exact values and optimum-set counts on finite ranges. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem is restricted to connected crown graphs. Finite verification covers support profiles through \(n=50\) and direct subset enumeration through \(n=6\); it does not replace the universal proof. An older or poorly indexed equivalent statement under \((1,t)\)-domination or \((0,k)\)-pitchfork terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact \(k\)-limited domination and optimal-set counts for crown graphs
